newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained unchanged on Tuesday amid dull trading as buyers kept to the sidelines owing to lack of funds, dealers said.

"Trading remained dull because there was a bank holiday today," dealer Nasim Usman said. "Rates are likely to remain at these levels in the near term as mills are short of funds, while sellers also appear in no hurry to unload stocks."
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,200/2,300 rupees per maund (37.32 kg),
